notes:
更简洁：移除「暂停代理」，主开关就是全部。

## 移除

- **「暂停代理」功能整体下线**（托盘三档子菜单、首页暂停按钮、倒计时横幅、
  定时自动重连）。它只是「断开 + 定时重连」的一层包装，与主开关一键
  断开/连接高度重叠；相关的持久化状态、冷启动守卫与自动连接豁免逻辑
  一并拆除，连接路径更短、更可预期。需要暂停就点断开，需要恢复就点连接。

## 优化

- 托盘菜单与首页卡片随之精简；断开状态不再有「已暂停」分支状态。

## 兼容性

账号、订阅、协议、更新签名公钥、各平台升级身份均未改变。
内核基线 mihomo v1.19.30。Flutter 3.47.2 / Dart 3.13.2。
notesEn:
Simpler: the pause feature is gone — the main switch is all you need.

## Removed

- **The "pause connection" feature is fully removed** (tray submenu with three
  durations, home-screen pause button, countdown banner, timed auto-resume).
  It was a wrapper around "disconnect + a reconnect timer" and overlapped the
  main switch's one-tap disconnect/connect; its persisted state, cold-start
  hydration guard and auto-connect exemptions are removed with it, leaving a
  shorter, more predictable connection path. To pause, disconnect; to resume,
  connect.

## Improved

- The tray menu and home card are simpler accordingly; the disconnected state
  no longer has a separate "paused" variant.

## Compatibility

Accounts, subscriptions, protocols, update-signing keys, and per-platform
upgrade identities are unchanged. Core baseline mihomo v1.19.30.
Flutter 3.47.2 / Dart 3.13.2.
